title: First Stylesheet
prompt:
Write your first external-stylesheet pattern, inline in one file:

- A `<style>` block containing a rule for `h1` that sets `color` (any color you like).
- A second rule for `p` that sets `font-size` to a value with units (e.g. `18px`).
- Every declaration must end with a semicolon.
boilerplate:
My styled page

Paragraphs deserve nice type too.

tests.name: has a style block
tests.hint: Internal styles live between <style> and </style> — usually in the <head>.

tests.name: h1 rule sets color
tests.hint: h1 { color: seagreen; } — property, colon, value, semicolon.

tests.name: p rule sets font-size with units
tests.hint: font-size: 18px; — a bare number is not a size.
